fusions.name: Whipstitch
fusions.desc: Stitches a strand through a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 piercing damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Throws a sheet of woven hair over everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and draws it tight, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour and leaving each target [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Sutures
fusions.desc: Stitches wounds shut with your own hair. It restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Penitent's Shirt
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, your haircloth shirt builds a stack on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
